title: Installation of Urban RCC – Maharashtra Nagar

description:
The installation of the Urban Rotary Community Corps (RCC) Maharashtra Nagar marks an important step towards empowering local residents to take an active role in community development. The RCC provides a platform for residents to come together, identify local challenges and work collectively towards sustainable solutions in areas such as education, healthcare, sanitation and community welfare.

The RCC was formally installed on 11 October 2026, with Ankush Chorghe taking charge as President, Rajendra Mhatugude as Secretary and Rani Shinde as Treasurer. The installation was held in the presence of District Governor Rtn. Rajan Dua, Club President Rtn. Nalini Kannan and members of Rotary Club of Deonar.

Through this initiative, residents of Maharashtra Nagar gain an organised platform to lead meaningful community initiatives, supported by the experience and guidance of Rotary Club of Deonar.
